description: Use when an agent has several options and no reason to prefer any, and the choice has to be defensible: picks one or more items from the list you send, with or without repeats, and tells you how many it had to choose from. Do not use to order the whole list (/v1/random/shuffle) or to draw a number in a range (/v1/random/number). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

count.description: How many to pick, 1-100. Defaults to 1.

items.description: The options, comma-separated. A JSON array of strings is also accepted in a POST body.

repeat.description: Allow the same item more than once. Defaults to false.

name: random_pick
title: Random pick
